display_long_description:
The most complete truck driving simulator on Meta Quest — built from the ground up for VR.

Truck VR drops you into the cab of a real truck in a massive open world spanning city streets, open highways, countryside roads, and off-road terrain. Multiple trucks to unlock and drive. Dynamic weather. Full day/night cycle. One seamless world with no loading screens.

SIX MODES. ONE OPEN WORLD.

🚛 Cargo Delivery — load up and haul freight across the full map. Real routes, real pressure, real satisfaction when you deliver.

🏙️ City Driving — navigate dense city streets with traffic, intersections, and urban chaos. The most immersive city truck experience in VR.

🅿️ Truck Parking — precision challenges in tight real-world environments. Nail the angle, stick the reverse, beat the clock.

🛣️ Highway Long Haul — open road, big rig, full throttle. Long intercity routes with real traffic and changing weather conditions.

🌍 Free Roam — take any truck, go anywhere, drive for as long as you want. No objectives. No limits.

🪨 Off-Road — leave the road behind. Rough terrain, steep inclines, and conditions that push every truck to its limit.

WHY TRUCK VR STANDS OUT

✔ Multiple trucks — each with unique handling and realistic physics
✔ Full open world — city, highway, countryside, and off-road in one map
✔ Dynamic weather — rain, fog, clear skies that change as you drive
✔ Day/night cycle — dawn, dusk, and everything in between
✔ Built natively for Quest 2, Quest 3, and Quest 3S
✔ No loadi
